reason: I feed five mouths including the strays behind my house, so I buy the big sacks of dry food and work out the cost per meal. RM 2.80 for one small pouch that is gone in one sitting for one cat, or RM 20 for just 1kg of dry, does not fit my budget. I would follow the page and take the free pack, that is all.
objection: Too costly per meal for the number of cats I feed, and "no pork ingredients" is not the same as a halal logo, so I am not sure I want it in my house anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A big sack of dry food (7kg or more) at around RM 7 to RM 8 per kg, with a proper halal certification on the pack, sold somewhere I can just pick it up during my grocery run.
